get.summary: The Server's version, its library, the machine it runs on and the state of its Worker.
The viewport: its mesh, camera and size. Frames come over the /ws/viewport WebSocket.

put.summary: Shows a mesh file in the viewport.

get.summary: A node's preview as a PNG, by the hash an event carried. It never changes, so cache it for ever.
The Server's library: its settings, its size and whether a rescan is running.
One page of projects: by name, or by relevance when searching.

post.summary: Writes a new project's files. It reaches the listings once the index has caught up.
Copies a shipped compound into the library as a file, so that it can be edited.
Writes a new, empty graph file. It reaches the listings once the index has caught up.

get.summary: One page of the tags on projects, by name, with how many projects carry each.
One page of shared assets with their usage counts: by name, or by relevance when searching.
One page of the tags on shared assets, by name, with how many assets carry each.
What saving a shared asset would touch: its dependent projects, and how many are pinned.
The open graphs.

post.summary: Opens a graph file, or joins the session that has it open, and starts evaluating it.

get.summary: The whole document, its undo history and the newest previews.

delete.summary: Ends a session. Unsaved edits refuse this unless discard is set.

get.summary: Every node this graph can use, with ports and settings, for a palette.
The compounds this graph can hold, and the path that opens the graph behind each.

post.summary: Saves some nodes as a new compound beside the graph and holds it in their place, as one undo step.
Applies a batch of edits, whole or not at all, as one undo step.
Takes back the newest batch, whichever client sent it.
Puts back the newest undone batch.
Writes the document to its file. A file changed on disk refuses this unless force is set.
Evaluates again, which also rewrites previews a deleted cache has lost.
Writes a node's picture at the size the graph computes it. /previews/{hash} serves the PNG.

put.summary: Chooses the folder of baked maps this graph's Mesh Map nodes read, and remembers it beside the file.

get.summary: The events after a number. /ws/graphs/{id}?since= sends the same events as they happen.
The open stacks.

post.summary: Opens a layer stack, or joins the session that has it open.
Writes a new stack with a base and a paint layer, and opens it.

get.summary: The whole stack, its history and the newest maps.

delete.summary: Ends a session. Unsaved edits refuse this unless discard is set.

post.summary: Applies a batch whole or not at all, as one undo step. A stroke is a list of stamps, never pixels.
Takes back the newest batch, whichever client sent it.
Puts back the newest undone batch.
Writes the pixels and then the stack. A file changed on disk refuses this unless force is set.
Composites again, which also rewrites maps a deleted cache has lost.

get.summary: A digest of each map as it stands, the same one an export reports, with no pixels in the reply.

post.summary: Evaluates from nothing and writes each map to a file, and says where and what they hold.

get.summary: The events after a number. /ws/stacks/{id}?since= sends the same events as they happen.
Every job the Server remembers, newest first, and the sequence to follow from.

post.summary: Queues a bake, or answers from the cache when the same bake has been made.

get.summary: One job.

post.summary: Asks a job to stop. A running job stops at the end of its row of the atlas.

get.summary: The events after a number. /ws/jobs?since= sends the same events as they happen.
An 8-bit PNG of one map of a finished bake.

projects.description: The projects that depend on the asset, directly or through other assets.

pinned.description: How many of Projects a pin holds back; the rest rebuild.

unreadableDocuments.description:
Project and asset documents the index could not read. They may depend on the asset too, so a value above zero
means the counts are a lower bound.

items.description: One page of the dependent projects.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

AssetImpact.description: What saving a shared asset would touch: "affects 412 projects, 3 pinned" (plan §5).

total.description: How many assets match, on all pages.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

path.description: The asset's file, relative to `shared/`, with forward slashes.

revision.description: The content hash of the asset's file, or null when the file is missing.

usageCount.description: How many projects reference the asset directly.

AssetSummary.description: One shared asset as the browser shows it.

scale.description:
What a stored unit value is multiplied by to get the measurement back, for a signed map in an integer format;
zero when there is nothing to undo.

BakedMapFile.description: One baked map, as a file.

low.description: The mesh baked onto, which must have texture coordinates.

output.description: The folder the maps are written to.

cage.description: A mesh with the low mesh's faces, moved outward, which the rays start from.

maps.description:
What to bake beyond `normal` and `height`, which are always baked: `ao`, `bent`,
`curvature`, `thickness`, `position`, `world`, `id`.

supersampling.description: How many samples along each side of a texel.

occlusionRays.description: How many rays a texel's occlusion is estimated with.

searchRadius.description: How far a ray looks, as a fraction of the high mesh's diagonal.

occlusionRadius.description: How far an occluder counts, as a fraction of the diagonal.

skew.description: How far rays lean from the smoothed direction towards the low mesh's own normal, 0 to 1.

skewMap.description: A grey image saying where to apply the skew, or null for everywhere.

matchByName.description: Whether a part of the low mesh only strikes the high part of the same name.

gutter.description: How many texels of dilation surround each chart.

name.description: The stem of each file's name, or null for the low mesh's.

BakeRequest.description:
A high-to-low bake. Everything is a path on the Server's machine, and the results are files there: a client
sends paths and gets paths, whichever client it is (plan §8).

covered.description: How many texels held chart content.

missed.description: How many found no source and took the closest point instead.

warnings.description: What could not be baked as asked.

cached.description: Whether this was found in the cache and nothing ran.

GraphCommand.description: One edit. Commands in a batch run in order, and every command sees the ones before it.

label.description: What the undo history calls it, or null for a name from the commands.

merge.description:
True to fold this batch into the last one when both change the same things, so that a whole drag is one undo.
A client leaves it false on the first batch of a drag.

GraphCommandBatch.description: Some edits, applied whole or not at all, and undone as one step.

width.description: Its width, or null for the standard size.

height.description: Its height, or null for the standard size.

ref.description: A negative number the client picks. The reply says which identity it became.
A negative number the client picks. The reply says which identity it became.

GraphCommandGraphAddGroup.description: Draws a group frame round some nodes.

ref.description:
A negative number the client picks. Later commands in this batch may use it wherever they name a node, and the
reply says which identity it became.

GraphCommandGraphAddParameter.description: Exposes a new parameter. Its name must be free, and its default must suit its kind and range.

GraphCommandGraphAddPort.description: Gives the graph a new port. Its boundary node shows it at once, and a holding graph after a save.

GraphCommandGraphConnect.description: Wires an output to an input, replacing what was on that input.

GraphCommandGraphDisconnect.description: Takes the wire off an input.

GraphCommandGraphMoveNodes.description: Moves nodes. A move never evaluates anything.

GraphCommandGraphRemoveGroup.description: Takes a group frame away. Its nodes stay.

GraphCommandGraphRemoveNodes.description: Removes nodes, and the wires that touch them.

GraphCommandGraphRemovePort.description: Takes a port away, with the wires on its boundary node. Undoing it puts them back.

GraphCommandGraphSetComment.description: Changes a note: anything left null stays as it is. A note moved by hand sends this on every step.

GraphCommandGraphSetGroup.description: Changes a group: anything left null stays as it is.

name.description: The parameter as it is called now.

parameter.description: What it becomes, which may rename it. Expressions keep the old name until edited.

GraphCommandGraphSetParameter.description: Replaces a parameter where it stands. Dragging its default sends this on every step.

name.description: The port as it is called now.

direction.description: Input or Output, which cannot change.

port.description: What it becomes. A kind its wires cannot carry is refused until they are gone.

GraphCommandGraphSetPort.description: Changes a port where it stands, and keeps the wires on its boundary node under a new name.

GraphCommandGraphSetSetting.description: Sets a setting of the graph: `baseWidth`, `baseHeight` or `seed`.

GraphCommandGraphSetText.description: Sets a text setting on a node, such as a blend mode.

value.description: One number per lane of the port.

GraphCommandGraphSetValue.description: Sets the numbers on a node's input. This is what a slider sends.

id.description: What a command names it by. It never changes and is never reused while a session lasts.

x.description: Its left edge on the canvas.

y.description: Its top edge on the canvas.

type.description: Its node type's path, as `/node-types` lists it.

readOnly.description: True for a compound that ships with Patina, which opens to be read.

GraphCompound.description: A compound a graph can hold, and the graph behind it.

name.description:
The copy's node type. It cannot be a shipped one's, since a shipped compound is never shadowed. Null for the
shipped name and " Copy".

graph.description:
An open graph whose compounds folder takes it, so that the graph can hold it, or null for
`shared/graphs`'s.

path.description: Relative to the library, with forward slashes, as `POST /graphs` takes it.

GraphCreatedNode.description: Which identity a client's `ref` became, on a node, a group or a note.

name.description: The graph's name. The Server makes its file name from it.

project.description: A project's path below `projects/` to put it in, or null for `shared/graphs`.

nodes.description: Nodes that are new or differ, whole.

settings.description: Graph settings that are new or differ.

parameters.description: The whole list of exposed parameters, or null when it did not change.

groups.description: The whole list of groups, or null when it did not change.

comments.description: The whole list of notes, or null when it did not change.

interface.description: The whole list of interface ports, or null when it did not change.

GraphDelta.description: What changed in the document, the same for an edit, an undo and a redo.

node.description: The node it concerns, or null.

port.description: The port it concerns, or null.

GraphDiagnostic.description: Something a graph's compiler or its file's reader has to say.

GraphEdgeState.description: One wire, from an output to an input.

created.description: What a batch created under a `ref`.

GraphEditResult.description: The reply to an edit, an undo, a redo or a save.

revision.description: The document revision it shows; during a drag this trails the newest.

compiled.description: True if the plan was compiled; false if the numbers were written into the last one.

ran.description: How many operations ran. The rest came from the result cache.

reused.description: How many operations already had a result.

milliseconds.description: How long the Worker took, previews included.

previews.description: The previews that differ from the last evaluation's. All of them are in the state.

error.description: Why it did not finish, or null. "No Vulkan" means the Worker has no GPU.

revision.description: The document's revision when it was sent.

history.description: The undo history when it was sent.

label.description: What the edit, undo or redo was called.

GraphEvent.description:
One numbered event of a session. Sequence numbers rise by one, so a client that sees a gap has missed something
and reads `/events` or the state. Every client gets every event, its own edits included.

events.description: The events after the number asked for, oldest first.

GraphEventPage.description: The events after a number, for a client that does not hold a WebSocket or has missed some.

edit.description: The edit to the graph the selection came from.

GraphExtraction.description: A selection saved as a compound. The edit undoes as one step, and the file stays.

name.description: Its node type's path, such as `Masks/Rust Edge`, which is also its file below `Compounds`.

nodes.description: The nodes. The wires that cross into them and out of them become its ports.

x.description: Where the node holding it goes.

y.description: Where the node holding it goes.

GraphExtractRequest.description: Moves some nodes into a new compound beside the graph and puts a node holding it in their place.

id.description: What a command names it by. It never changes and is never reused while a session lasts.

GraphGroupState.description: A frame round some nodes. It holds no geometry: a client draws it from where its nodes are.

canUndo.description: Whether there is an edit to undo.

canRedo.description: Whether there is an edit to redo.

dirty.description: Whether the document differs from the file.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the PNG's bytes, in lower-case hex.

GraphImage.description: Where a full-size picture is: `GET /api/v1/previews/{hash}`. Pixels never cross JSON.

port.description: Its output port, or the usage of an Output node, as a preview names them.

GraphImageRequest.description: Asks for a node's picture at the size the graph computes it.

name.description: What an edge in the holding graph calls it.

direction.description: Input or Output, as the holding graph sees it.

kind.description: What it carries: Image, Float, Float4 and so on.

default.description: What an unwired input takes, one number per lane, or empty for the kind's zero.

GraphInterfacePort.description: One port a graph has when another graph holds it as a node.

folder.description: A folder holding a bake's files, or null to read none.

GraphMeshMapsRequest.description: Says which folder of baked maps a graph's Mesh Map nodes read.

id.description: The node's identity, which is never reused within a session.

values.description: The numbers set on its inputs, by port. An input left out takes the type's default.

texts.description: The text settings set on it, by name.

GraphNodeState.description: A node as a document holds it.

path.description: What a document stores, such as `Colour/Levels`.

title.description: The last segment of the path.

hasPreview.description: Whether the type declares that its picture is worth showing.

settings.description: Its text settings, set with GraphSetText.

GraphNodeType.description: A node a client can add, for a palette.

path.description: The graph file on the Server's machine, absolute or relative to the library.

GraphOpenRequest.description: Opens a texture graph for editing. Opening a file that is already open joins its session.

kind.description: What it carries: Image, Float, Float4 and so on.

default.description: The numbers an unset input takes.

oneOf.description: What numbers mean anything on it, or null when it declares none.

GraphPortDefinition.description: One port of a node type.

minimum.description: The smallest number that means anything.

maximum.description: The largest number that means anything.

softMinimum.description: Where a slider starts, when the port's meaning gives that. Numbers go on past it.

softMaximum.description: Where a slider ends, the same way.

GraphPortRange.description: What an input port says about its numbers. Any end may be open, as null.

port.description: Its output port, or the usage of an Output node.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the PNG's bytes, in lower-case hex.

GraphPreview.description: Where a node's picture is: `GET /api/v1/previews/{hash}`. Pixels never cross JSON.

minimum.description: Its lower bound, or null for none.

maximum.description: Its upper bound, or null for none.

accepted.description: The values it may take; empty for any.

GraphSettingDefinition.description: A value a node type or a graph lets an author set.

revision.description: Counts changes to the document, undo included.

sequence.description: The last event's number: pass it as `since` to follow from exactly here.

edges.description: The wires, by the input they arrive at.

interface.description: The ports it has when another graph holds it.

groups.description: Its group frames, in file order.

previews.description: The newest preview of each node.

repairs.description: What reading the file had to drop or fix.

oneOf.description: The last evaluation, or null before the first.

settled.description: The newest revision with nothing left to evaluate. Below Revision, evaluation is behind.

readOnly.description: True when this graph cannot be edited or saved: a compound that ships with Patina.

GraphState.description: The reply to `GET /api/v1/graphs/{id}`: the whole document as the Server holds it.

GraphSummary.description: An open graph, for a list.

HostInfo.description: The machine and runtime a process runs on.

path.description: The project's folder, relative to `projects/`, with forward slashes.

pinned.description: True when a pin holds the project back, so a change to the asset does not reach it.

ImpactedProject.description: A project that depends on a shared asset.

sequence.description: The number, rising with each event.

job.description: The job as it now stands.

JobEvent.description: A job changing. Numbered, so a client that dropped its socket can ask what it missed.

JobPage.description: Every job the Server remembers, and the sequence a client can follow from.

key.description: The build key of what it makes.

progress.description: How far through it is, 0 to 1.

attempts.description: How many Workers have started it.

created.description: When it was asked for, in UTC.

cancelRequested.description: Whether a client has asked for it to stop.

JobState.description: A piece of work the Server owns, which outlives the Worker running it and the Server itself.

path.description: The library's folder on the Server's machine.

schemaVersion.description: The version of `library.yaml` as it stands on disk.

texelDensity.description: The texel density new projects start from, in texels per metre.

defaultShader.description: The shader new projects start from.

exportTargets.description: The export targets the library builds for.

assetCount.description: The shared assets in the index.

indexing.description: Whether a rescan is running; counts and pages may lag the files until it ends.

LibraryInfo.description: The reply to `GET /api/v1/library`: what opening a library reads, and nothing more.

name.description: The project's display name. The Server makes its folder from it.

folder.description: Folders below `projects/` to put it in, with forward slashes, such as `props`.

total.description: How many projects match, on all pages.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

path.description: The project's folder, relative to `projects/`, with forward slashes.

referenceCount.description: How many shared assets the project references directly.

ProjectSummary.description: One project as the browser shows it. The project itself loads on open.

flow.description: How much one stamp lays down, 0 to 1.

opacity.description: How much a whole stroke can lay down, 0 to 1.

spacing.description: How far apart stamps are, as a share of the radius.

falloff.description: How soft its edge is, 0 to 1.

StackBrush.description: A brush. Everything but the radius has the value a new brush has.

usage.description: Its usage: baseColor, roughness and so on.

StackCommand.description: One edit of a stack. A batch of these is one undo step.

StackCommandBatch.description: Edits applied whole or not at all, as one undo step.

values.description: What a fill writes to each channel, as four numbers. Ignored for other kinds.

StackCommandStackAddLayer.description: Adds a layer at the top of the stack.

delta.description: How many places, up the stack when positive.

StackCommandStackMoveLayer.description: Moves a layer up or down its list.

opacity.description: How much of it composites, 0 to 1.

StackCommandStackSetLayer.description: Changes what a layer's row shows. What is null stays.

stroke.description: A name the client chose for this drag.

channel.description: Which of its channels. Ignored for a mask.

brush.description: The brush, which the first part decides.

colour.description: Red, green, blue and alpha, 0 to 1, which the first part decides.

stamps.description: Where the brush went since the last part.

open.description: Whether more of this drag is coming.

mask.description: Whether this paints the layer's mask.

StackCommandStackStroke.description:
Part of a stroke: where the brush went, never what it left behind. A drag sends several of these with one
Stroke and they make one undo step, ended by one with Open false.

path.description: The file to write, absolute or relative to the library.

StackCreateRequest.description: Creates a layer stack: one base fill, and one paint layer over it.

painted.description: Each channel a stroke touched, as layer and usage.

StackDelta.description: What an edit changed, so that a client need not read the whole stack again.

StackEditResult.description: Where an edit left the session.

compiled.description: Whether the plan had to compile.

repaired.description: How many of those ran over the tiles a stroke changed rather than the whole image.

reused.description: How many came from the cache.

diagnostics.description: Why it could not evaluate, or what it warned about.

error.description: Why the evaluation failed, or null.

revision.description: The revision of the document after it.

StackEvent.description: Something that happened to a stack, with the same kinds and numbering as a graph's events.

folder.description: Where, absolute or relative to the library.

StackExportRequest.description: Writes each channel of a stack to a file.

channels.description: Which channels it writes. Empty means all of them.

painted.description: Whether it names a paint file yet.

path.description: A `.vxlayers` file, absolute or relative to the library.

digest.description: SHA-256 of its pixels as 8-bit RGBA, row by row.

file.description: Where it was written, for an export.

StackPixels.description: A digest of a map's pixels, so that two pictures can be compared with neither crossing the API.

StackPreview.description: A map as a small picture, by the hash an event carries.

StackStamp.description: Where the brush goes, in texels from the image's top left.

set.description: The texture set this session paints.

sequence.description: The number of the last event it includes.

settled.description: The newest revision an evaluation has reached.

StackState.description: A whole stack: everything a client needs to draw it, and no pixels.

dirty.description: Whether it has edits no file holds.

StackSummary.description: An open stack, for a list.

apiVersion.description: The major version of the REST API; it is the `v1` in the URL.

library.description: The library this Server owns, or null when it was started without one.

host.description: The machine and runtime the Server runs on.

worker.description: The Worker process as the Server sees it.

count.description: How many projects or assets carry it.

TagCount.description: A tag, and how many items carry it.

total.description: How many tags there are, on all pages.

offset.description: The offset the page starts at.

limit.description: The most items a page holds.

TagPage.description: One page of tags, by name.

distance.description: From the model's centre, in bounding radii.

ViewportCameraState.description: The viewport's camera: an orbit around the model.

path.description: The file's path, on the Server's machine.

ViewportMeshRequest.description: Asks the viewport to show a mesh.

mesh.description: The mesh's path, or null when none is open.

width.description: The size clients asked for, in pixels.

height.description: The size clients asked for, in pixels.

renderScale.description: The share of that size frames are rendered at, which drops while a client cannot keep up.

frames.description: How many frames this Server has published.

error.description: Why the last command failed, or null.

ViewportState.description: The reply to `GET /api/v1/viewport`. The Server owns all of this; a Worker can die without losing it.

connected.description: Whether a Worker is connected and answering.

version.description: The Worker's release version, from its hello.

processId.description: The Worker's process id, from its hello.

uptimeSeconds.description: How long the Worker has run, from its last health reply.

workingSetBytes.description: The Worker's memory, from its last health reply.

WorkerStatus.description: The Worker as the Server sees it. All but `Connected` are null while there is none.
